title: Matki Dhol | Matki Dance | मटकी ढोल पर आसान स्टेप्स | Easy Steps With Tutorial | Wedding Dhol Dance

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains the context of the dance and encourages the viewer to subscribe. She demonstrates full choreographies first, then breaks down steps with counts.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction and welcome to the channel
Explanation of Matki or Dhol dance in weddings
Demonstration of the routine with music

what_works: Demonstrating with music first gives clear context

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher speaks to camera introducing herself and the dance style
Teacher dances full routine in a room with music playing
